Further, in accordance with Rane's lnsider code, the 'Trading window' would remain closed for Promoters, Directors, other connected persons and designated employees of the company from June 30, 2026 to August 15, 2026 (both days inclusive) for the above purpose.
To consider and approve the unaudited financial results of the Company for the quarter ending 30th June, 2026.
To consider and approve the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026
